_comment: Information and Communication Technology -- Secondary School Teachers' Diploma syllabus.
LEVEL / YEAR. As the cover and title page say; 2025 as on the cover and copyright line.
LAID OUT BY COURSE (Year -> Course -> matrix, Year.Course.Topic), as Computer Science: the engine (courseOutline) sets the year pages, courses and contents.
MATRIX NUMBERS. renumberMatrix, counted afresh within each course: 1.3.4.1.3 typed twice; "1.4..1.1" (two dots);
AI course: topic "1.6.7.4 AI TOOLS" (should be 1.6.4), so 1.6.5 followed 1.6.3; 1.6.6.1's competence typed 1.6.5.3.1. CDC to confirm.
TITLE-PAGE PICTURE. A vector EMF on the manuscript title page cannot be converted and is left out; the cover and title page are drawn from the theme.
COPYRIGHT. The manuscript has the copyright line twice, the first cut short ("© Curriculum Development Centre, 202"); that one goes.
REFERENCES (setHeading, keep). As in Computer Science: each course's reading sits under its course name, and the reading labels
(styled anything from Heading 1 to plain) are small bold labels under it, out of the contents.

PROOFREAD round 1 (Google Drive comments, 2026-10-22..25): 392 comments. 350 'Remove Boldface' -- the manuscript sets activities/standards in Word's Strong style with bold switched off by hand; the importer now honours that (engine). The rest below.
